title: Borth Sea Defenses Video 3 Feb 2011
what_it_shows: Silent amateur b-roll from a dedicated 'BorthSeaDefense' channel, filming the coastal-defence/reef construction site at Borth in February 2011, early in the works.
notes: No spoken narration or captions (silent construction b-roll); no automatic captions available on YouTube for this video.

title: Borth sea defences and reef
what_it_shows: Short amateur clip of two excavators working on the offshore rock reef at Borth's southern end, filmed from the beach, September 2011.

frames.caption: Two excavators building the offshore rock reef at Borth's southern end, seen from the beach; waves breaking on the sand in the foreground. Confirmed by viewing the frame.

notes: No dialogue/captions; silent b-roll. Frame viewed and confirmed to match the dossier's description of diggers building the reef.

title: Borth Beach Sea Defence Works August 2011
date: 2015-06-12 (upload date; footage itself is captioned August 2011)
what_it_shows: Amateur clip along Borth's seafront showing houses on the beach road, construction plant and large stockpiled rock/shingle piles from the coastal-defence works, August 2011.

frames.caption: Borth seafront houses beside the beach, with excavators, dump trucks and a large stockpile of rock/quarried material for the coastal-defence works in the foreground. Confirmed by viewing the frame.

notes: No dialogue/captions; silent b-roll. Frame viewed and confirmed.

title: borth sea defence 2012
what_it_shows: Longer amateur video, description 'komatsu 450 separating rock and shingle', showing heavy plant sorting/grading rock and shingle material as part of the Borth coastal-defence works, into 2012 (matches the dossier's March 2012 completion date for the reef/coastal-defence works).
notes: Duration (543 s) exceeds the 480 s embed threshold, so link with timestamp per Lior's preference rather than embed. No captions available.
